description:
About Lundin Software

  • Software company with Headquarters in Bucharest since 2006
  • Flagship product is Gannet - Aircraft Maintenance Information Software
  • Other products developed for specific customers / business types
  • Customers in 17 countries on 5 continents

 

Responsibilities

  • Part of a team that analyze, develop and maintain the Gannet software
  • Follow and understand the Design Patterns/Frameworks used inside organization
  • Develop and maintain the SQL database, scripts, queries, LINQ Queries
  • Participate in Application and Database design
  • Discuss with customers and implement new functionalities

 

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree OR Currently Involved in Computer Science University or related one
  • Experience with developing Microsoft .NET Windows Applications in WPF 
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server/Entity Framework ORM/LINQ
  • Experience with coding and testing applications written in C#
  • Experience in developing REST Web APIs
  • Keep always updated with the newest Microsoft technologies.
  • Nice to have knowledge/experience in Windows Azure development
  • Nice to have knowledge/experience in Web Stack ( Blazor App / Razor pages )
  • Nice to have knowledge/experience in Mobile App development (Microsoft Xamarin / MAUI )
  • Nice to have knowledge/experience in Microsoft Reporting Services / Power BI
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • Good English skills

 

We Offer

  • Compensation in accordance with experience
  • Performance bonuses
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Relaxed office atmosphere
  • Colleagues with over 20 years of software development experience
  • Flexible benefits
  • Travel opportunity
